desc: Derive the per-letter transition and cost model.
Design an efficient distance-transform dynamic programming recurrence for fixed target frequency \(k\).
Exhaustively validate the fixed-\(k\) DP against a brute-force solver, including boundary cases involving `'z'`.
Validate the candidate-frequency reduction against exhaustive small cases.
Prove that the selected candidate frequencies capture every optimum, or replace them with a correct candidate/range strategy.
Run sample and adversarial tests, including empty-result, all-distinct, highly imbalanced, and `'z'` cases.
Finalize the implementation and complexity justification.
